implementation.contract:
PSEUDOCODE CONTRACT — RTL8019AS

Represent the complete VMB-visible behavior of the RTL8019AS, not only this specimen.
ON RESET falling-edge sampling: latch JP/PNP/BS/IOS/IRQS configuration inputs as defined by the component record. After sampling, honor their documented alternate BROM-bus roles.
Expose ISA address/data/control interface, reset, IOCHRDY, selected IRQ behavior, boot-ROM interface, EEPROM interface, and Ethernet-facing behavior required by VMB.
If Analyzer proves a configuration input fixed, accept a compile-time default. If a source is a user control, bind it to the machine PCB-instance control. If a source can change live, expose a runtime input.
Never infer IO base, IRQ, ROM mapping, or mode from board identity. Those values/connections arrive from Board IR.
Firmware bytes are not embedded in this module.
implementation.note: CP42 IC-boundary extraction. ISA decode/configuration, EEPROM, boot ROM, IRQ routing and host Ethernet transport remain board/external concerns.

implementation.contract:
PSEUDOCODE CONTRACT — SST39SF040

Implement 512 KiB x8 parallel flash behavior at VMB resolution, including reads and guest-visible programming/erase behavior where exercised. Backing payload size is exactly 524288 bytes.
Firmware payload is selected from the Firmware Store and copied/installed into the machine-local PCB instance. Runtime writes modify only that instance copy. Missing payload remains unresolved; do not invent contents.
implementation.note: Source-backed Code Store binding promoted by CP39; board wiring and programmed contents remain external.

implementation.contract:
PSEUDOCODE CONTRACT — 93LC46C

Implement 1 Kbit Microwire EEPROM with CS/CLK/DI/DO live behavior. ORG selects x8 when low and x16 when high; honor static, reset/configured, or live wiring as represented by Board IR.
Persistent contents belong to the machine-local PCB instance. Firmware Store may supply an installable initial payload, but component identity does not imply payload identity. Implement the full VMB-visible behavior for both legal organizations.
implementation.note: Source-backed Code Store binding promoted by CP39; board wiring and programmed contents remain external.
